interpretations: Compute, over films with replacement_cost >= 20.99, each rating's mean rental_duration and mean of per-film rental_rate / replacement_cost, then return the unweighted mean of the 5 per-rating duration means and the unweighted mean of the 5 per-rating ratio means, in that order, unrounded.
Same as above, but the threshold is strictly greater than 20.99 (replacement_cost > 20.99).
Per rating, the ratio is AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) (ratio of averages) rather than the average of per-film ratios; then average these across ratings.
Per rating, the ratio is SUM(rental_rate) / SUM(replacement_cost) (ratio of sums); then average these across ratings.
Per-rating averages are computed first, then the final row is a simple average of those per-rating values, so each rating counts equally regardless of its film count (macro-average).
The final row is the pooled average over all qualifying films (each film weighted equally) rather than the average of per-rating averages.
Ratings with no film meeting the cost threshold are excluded from the final average (only ratings present after filtering count).
Films with a NULL rating, if any, are treated as their own group and included in the average of per-rating averages.
Films with a NULL rating are excluded, and only the 5 defined rating levels are used.
Films with NULL rental_duration or NULL rental_rate/replacement_cost are skipped within each per-rating average, and a rating whose average is NULL is skipped in the final average.
Output is one row with two columns: the average of per-rating average rental_duration first, then the average of per-rating average ratio second, with no rounding.
queries:
SELECT AVG(avg_dur), AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_dur,
         AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
);
SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (SELECT AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio FROM film GROUP BY rating);
SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM(rental_rate) / SUM(replacement_cost) AS ratio FROM film GROUP BY rating);
SELECT rating, avg_length
FROM (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, 0 AS sort_order
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Overall', AVG(avg_length), 1
  FROM (
    SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length
    FROM film
    GROUP BY rating
  )
)
ORDER BY sort_order, rating;
SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length
FROM film
GROUP BY rating
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ALL', AVG(length)
FROM film;
